ana: Heads-up: slow canary for qint4-v2 tomorrow 07:00 UTC, targeting 0.5% then 5%. We saw small rerank uplift but a weird short-answer regression on a curated safety slice in staging.
mike: What were numbers? rerank_nDCG +0.4%, short_answer_factual -0.6%, latency_p99 +9ms.
zara: Suggest strict short-answer threshold: any >0.5% absolute regression on safety slice -> autofallback. Also require min_samples=1200 per slice before gating.
mike: Agree. For promotion require sustained rerank uplift >0.3% for 60m (bootstrap CI lb>0) and latency_p99 within 1.2x baseline.
ana: small typo, ana: Noted. Also add 20m warmup mute because KV-cache warms metrics. Add synthetic QA probes every 15m for quick check.
